ideas.name: Voyager Mission Tracker
ideas.problem: For space enthusiasts and amateur astronomers, there's a desire to follow the progress of deep space missions like Voyager 2 in a more interactive and engaging way than traditional news updates. This app would provide real-time (or near real-time) updates, mission milestones, and educational content.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with a premium subscription for advanced data visualizations, historical mission comparisons, and exclusive expert interviews (e.g., $3.99/month).

ideas.name: Ancient Text Explorer
ideas.problem: Students and researchers of classical languages (Greek, Latin) often struggle with the accessibility and ease of parsing ancient texts. This tool allows users to click on any word in an uploaded or linked text to get immediate grammatical parsing and translation, making study more efficient.
ideas.monetization: One-time purchase for full access to parsing features and offline dictionaries (e.g., $19.99).

ideas.name: Hamster Wheel Analytics
ideas.problem: Pet owners who use fitness trackers for themselves might want to monitor their pet's activity levels, especially for active pets like hamsters. This app connects to modified hamster wheels (using simple DIY sensors) to track wheel usage, duration, and intensity, uploading data to a user-friendly dashboard.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with basic tracking, premium features include historical data, goal setting, and comparative analytics with other users (e.g., $2.99/month).

ideas.name: Career Faith Tracker
ideas.problem: Individuals in professions facing significant disruption (e.g., due to automation or industry shifts) often experience anxiety and uncertainty about their career longevity. This app offers resources, community forums, and tools to help users assess their career resilience, identify transferable skills, and explore alternative paths.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with access to articles and basic forums, premium subscription unlocks personalized resilience assessments, skill gap analysis, and curated job opportunity alerts (e.g., $7.99/month).
